name: Discussion Brief Cards
changes: Without Pro, the Refresh button of a discussion-list block now shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. Before, it did nothing. No discussion is read until Pro is on.
tip: Select Refresh on a card to load the current text and answer state after a discussion changes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Discussion Brief Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep project discussions beside your notes.
